name: Drug Regulatory Authority of Pakistan
description: Regulates drugs, biological products, medical devices, and dietary supplements in Pakistan under the Drugs Act 1976 and DRAP Act 2012.

name: Pakistan Standards and Quality Control Authority
description: Sets and enforces food and product quality standards in Pakistan. Implements Pure Food Laws and Pakistan Standards.

name: Directorate General of Drug Administration
description: Regulates pharmaceuticals, medical devices, and herbal medicines in Bangladesh under the Drugs Act 1940 (Bangladesh).

name: Bangladesh Standards and Testing Institution
description: Develops and enforces food and product standards in Bangladesh. Implements Bangladesh Standards.

name: National Medicines Regulatory Authority
description: Regulates medicines, medical devices, cosmetics, and borderline products in Sri Lanka under the NMRA Act No. 5 of 2015.

name: Sri Lanka Standards Institution
description: Develops Sri Lankan standards and certifies food products. Implements SLS (Sri Lanka Standards).

name: Department of Drug Administration (Nepal)
description: Regulates drugs, medical devices, and cosmetics in Nepal under the Drug Act 2035 BS (1978 AD).

name: Department of Food Technology and Quality Control
description: Regulates food safety and quality in Nepal under the Food Act 2023 BS and Food Regulation 2027 BS.

name: Bhutan Food and Drug Authority
description: Regulates drugs, food, cosmetics and medical devices in Bhutan. Aligns largely with Indian and WHO standards.

name: Maldives National Bureau of Statistics (Food/Drug arm)
description: The Maldives Food and Drug Authority (MFDA) regulates food safety and pharmaceuticals in Maldives.

name: Maldives Food and Drug Authority
description: Primary regulatory body for food, drugs, medical devices and cosmetics in the Maldives.

name: Ministry of Food and Drug Safety
description: Korea's primary regulator for food, drugs, cosmetics, and medical devices. Internationally respected; aligns with ICH, ISO, and Codex. Functional foods regulated under Health Functional Food Act.

name: Taiwan Food and Drug Administration
description: Regulates food, drugs, medical devices, and cosmetics in Taiwan under the Food Safety and Sanitation Act and Pharmaceutical Affairs Act.

name: Department of Health — Centre for Food Safety
description: The Centre for Food Safety (CFS) under the HKSAR Department of Health regulates food safety in Hong Kong.

name: Pharmacy and Poisons Board (Hong Kong)
description: Regulates pharmaceuticals and medical devices in Hong Kong under the Pharmacy and Poisons Ordinance.

name: Badan Pengawas Obat dan Makanan (Indonesia FDA)
description: Indonesia's National Agency of Drug and Food Control. Regulates drugs, food, medical devices, and health supplements under Government Regulation No. 72/1998.

name: Agricultural and Cooperatives Food Safety Office (Thailand)
description: Oversees agricultural food safety standards in Thailand under the Ministry of Agriculture and Cooperatives.

name: Food and Drug Administration Thailand
description: Thailand's FDA under the Ministry of Public Health regulates food, drugs, medical devices, cosmetics and health products.

name: Medical Device Authority Malaysia
description: Regulates medical devices in Malaysia under the Medical Device Act 2012.

name: National Pharmaceutical Regulatory Agency Malaysia
description: Regulates pharmaceuticals, traditional medicines, health supplements, and controlled drugs in Malaysia.

name: Food and Drug Administration Philippines
description: Philippines FDA regulates health products including food, drugs, devices, and cosmetics under RA 9711 (FDA Act of 2009).

name: Drug Administration of Vietnam
description: Regulates pharmaceuticals and medical devices in Vietnam under the Law on Pharmacy 2016.

name: Vietnam Food Administration
description: Regulates food safety in Vietnam under the Law on Food Safety 2010. Oversees functional foods and health supplements.

name: Traditional Medicine Department (Myanmar)
description: Regulates traditional and herbal medicines in Myanmar. Conventional drugs regulated under the Myanmar Food and Drug Law 1992.

name: Ministry of Agriculture Forestry and Fisheries Cambodia
description: Regulates food safety and agricultural products in Cambodia.

name: Brunei Darussalam Food Safety and Quality
description: Food safety and pharmaceutical regulation in Brunei under the Ministry of Health. Aligns with ASEAN harmonisation.

name: Ministry for Primary Industries New Zealand
description: Co-regulates food safety with Medsafe in New Zealand. FSANZ standards apply jointly with Australia.

name: Medicines and Medical Devices Safety Authority New Zealand
description: Regulates medicines and medical devices in New Zealand under the Medicines Act 1981. Aligned with TGA Australia.

name: Comisión Federal para la Protección contra Riesgos Sanitarios
description: Mexico's Federal Commission for Protection against Sanitary Risk. Regulates food, drugs, devices and supplements under LGSA (General Health Law).

name: Instituto Nacional de Vigilancia de Medicamentos y Alimentos
description: Colombia's national institute for pharmaceutical and food surveillance. Issues sanitary registrations for all health products.

name: Instituto de Salud Pública de Chile
description: Chile's public health institute regulates pharmaceuticals, medical devices, and health products under the Sanitary Code (DFL No. 725).

name: Administración Nacional de Medicamentos, Alimentos y Tecnología Médica
description: Argentina's national administration for drugs, food and medical technology. Issues registrations under MERCOSUR harmonised standards.

name: Dirección General de Medicamentos, Insumos y Drogas
description: Peru's directorate for medicines, supplies and drugs under the Ministry of Health. Regulates under Ley 26842 (General Health Law).

name: Swiss Agency for Therapeutic Products
description: Switzerland's regulator for therapeutic products (drugs and medical devices) under the Therapeutic Products Act (TPA/HMG). Closely aligned with EU but autonomous.

name: Federal Food Safety and Veterinary Office Switzerland
description: Switzerland's federal authority for food safety, aligned with EU Food Law but with Swiss-specific provisions in the Foodstuffs Act (LMG/LDA).

name: Norwegian Medicines Agency
description: Norway's medicines regulator. As EEA member, Norway applies EU pharmaceutical and medical device regulations (EMA decisions are binding).

name: Norwegian Food Safety Authority
description: Supervises food, animal health and plant health in Norway. EU food regulations apply via EEA Agreement.

name: Federal Service for Surveillance in Healthcare (Russia)
description: Russia's federal healthcare surveillance service regulating pharmaceuticals and medical devices under Federal Law No. 61-FZ on Drug Circulation.

name: Federal Service for Surveillance on Consumer Rights and Human Wellbeing
description: Russia's consumer rights and food safety authority. Regulates food, dietary supplements, and cosmetics. Sets CU (Customs Union/EAEU) standards jointly with Kazakhstan and Belarus.

name: Ministry of Health of Ukraine
description: Ukraine's Ministry of Health oversees pharmaceutical registration via the State Expert Centre. Ukraine is harmonising with EU regulations.

name: Chief Pharmaceutical Inspectorate of Poland
description: As EU member, Poland applies EU pharmaceutical regulations. GIF is the national competent authority for GMP inspections and pharmacovigilance.

name: State Institute for Drug Control Czech Republic
description: Czech Republic's state institute for drug control. Applies EU pharmaceutical and medical device regulations as EU member state.

name: National Institute of Pharmacy and Nutrition Hungary
description: Hungary's national institute for pharmacy and nutrition. Applies EU regulations; national NCA for pharmaceutical registration and food supplements.

name: National Agency for Medicines and Medical Devices Romania
description: Romania's pharmaceutical and medical device regulator. EU member applying EMA and MDR/IVDR regulations.

name: Bulgarian Drug Agency
description: Bulgaria's pharmaceutical regulator and EU NCA. Applies EU pharmaceutical regulations and MDR/IVDR as EU member state.

name: Agency for Medicinal Products and Medical Devices Croatia
description: Croatia's (HALMED) medicines and devices agency. EU member; applies EMA, MDR/IVDR, and EU food supplement regulations.

name: Medicines Control and Veterinary Drugs Regulatory Authority Kazakhstan
description: Kazakhstan's pharmaceutical regulator. Applies EAEU (Eurasian Economic Union) technical regulations for drugs and devices; aligns with CU standards.

name: Saudi Food and Drug Authority
description: Saudi Arabia's SFDA is one of the most active regulators in the GCC. Regulates food, drugs, medical devices, and health products. Issues mandatory product registrations for all food and health products.

name: Ministry of Health and Prevention UAE
description: UAE federal regulator for pharmaceuticals and health products. Dubai and Abu Dhabi have separate emirate-level health authorities (DHA, DOH/HAAD).

name: Emirates Authority for Standardization and Metrology
description: UAE's standardization authority that issues UAE.S standards for food products. All food products require conformity with Emirates standards.

name: Pharmaceutical and Medical Device Agency Turkey
description: Turkey's pharmaceutical and medical device regulator under the Ministry of Health. Turkey largely aligns with EU pharmaceutical regulations as a customs union partner.

name: Turkey Food Federation / Ministry of Agriculture (BSGM)
description: Turkey's General Directorate of Food and Control (BSGM) regulates food safety under the Food Codex Regulation. Largely harmonised with EU food law.

name: Ministry of Health Israel
description: Israel's Ministry of Health regulates pharmaceuticals, medical devices and food. Pharmaceutical registration via IMPA (Israel Medical Products Agency). Aligns with EMA and FDA approaches.

name: Egyptian Drug Authority
description: Egypt's pharmaceutical and medical device regulator, succeeding CAPA. Issues pharmaceutical marketing authorisations under Law No. 151 of 2019.

name: National Food Safety Authority Egypt
description: Egypt's food safety authority established under Law No. 1 of 2017. Consolidates food safety regulation formerly split across multiple ministries.

name: Jordan Food and Drug Administration
description: Jordan's Food and Drug Administration (JFDA) regulates pharmaceuticals, food, medical devices, and health supplements. Active regional regulator with GCC harmonisation.

name: Saudi Food and Drug Authority (GCC reference)
description: Kuwait Ministry of Health regulates pharmaceutical registration. GCC countries use a mutual recognition track; Saudi SFDA decisions often accepted.

name: Ministry of Public Health Qatar
description: Qatar's public health ministry regulates pharmaceuticals, food, and medical devices. QCS (Qatar General Organisation for Standards and Metrology) issues food standards.

name: National Health Regulatory Authority Bahrain
description: Bahrain's health regulatory authority. GCC harmonised pharmaceutical track; food standards under GSO (Gulf Standards Organisation).

name: Directorate of Pharmacy and Drug Control Oman
description: Oman's pharmaceutical regulator under the Ministry of Health. Applies GCC harmonised pharmaceutical regulations.

name: National Agency for Food and Drug Administration and Control Nigeria
description: Nigeria's primary food, drug, and medical device regulator under the NAFDAC Act. West Africa's most influential regulator. Issues product registrations mandatory for all regulated products.

name: Kenya Bureau of Standards
description: Kenya's standards body issues Kenya Standards (KS) for food. PPB (Pharmacy and Poisons Board) regulates pharmaceuticals; KEBS covers food.

name: Pharmacy and Poisons Board Kenya
description: Kenya's pharmaceutical and health product regulator. Issues product licences for drugs, health supplements, and medical devices.

name: South African Health Products Regulatory Authority
description: South Africa's pharmaceutical and medical device regulator, succeeding MCC. Issues marketing authorisations under the Medicines and Related Substances Act 101 of 1965.

name: Department of Agriculture, Land Reform and Rural Development SA
description: Regulates food safety for agricultural products in South Africa. Implements the Agricultural Products Standards Act.

name: Food and Drugs Authority Ghana
description: Ghana's food and drugs authority. Regulates food, pharmaceuticals, medical devices, and herbal medicines under FDA Act 851 of 2012.

name: Ethiopian Food and Drug Authority
description: Ethiopia's food and drug authority regulates pharmaceuticals, food, and medical devices under Proclamation No. 661/2009.

name: Tanzania Food and Drugs Authority
description: Tanzania's food and drugs authority regulates pharmaceuticals, food, medical devices, and health supplements under the Tanzania Food, Drugs and Cosmetics Act 2003.

name: Office National de Sécurité Sanitaire des Produits Alimentaires Morocco
description: Morocco's national food safety office regulates food safety and agricultural product standards. Morocco aligns food law with EU regulations.

name: Agence Nationale des Produits Pharmaceutiques Algeria
description: Algeria's national pharmaceutical products agency. Regulates drug registration, licensing, and pharmacovigilance under Executive Decree 92-284.

name: Direction de la Pharmacie et du Médicament Tunisia
description: Tunisia's pharmaceutical directorate under the Ministry of Health. Issues marketing authorisations for drugs and medical devices.

name: Food and Drug Board Senegal (DPML)
description: Senegal's pharmaceutical and food regulator under the Ministry of Health. Issues drug authorisations and enforces food safety under Code d'Hygiène.

name: Direction Générale de la Santé et de la Vétérinaire Ivory Coast
description: Ivory Coast's food and pharmaceutical regulator. WAEMU (West African Economic and Monetary Union) harmonisation applies.

name: Direction de la Pharmacie et du Médicament Cameroon
description: Cameroon's pharmaceutical regulatory directorate under the Ministry of Public Health. Issues marketing authorisations for drugs.

name: Medicines Control Authority of Zimbabwe
description: Zimbabwe's medicines control authority regulates pharmaceuticals and medical devices under the Medicines and Allied Substances Control Act.

name: National Drug Authority Uganda
description: Uganda's pharmaceutical and medical device regulator under the National Drug Policy and Authority Act Cap 206.

name: Rwanda Food and Drugs Authority
description: Rwanda's food and drugs authority, recently restructured. Issues drug marketing authorisations and food product approvals.

name: Zambia Medicines Regulatory Authority
description: Zambia's medicines regulatory authority under the Medicines and Allied Substances Act No. 3 of 2013.

name: Instituto Nacional de Farmácia e do Medicamento Angola
description: Angola's pharmaceutical regulatory authority issues drug marketing authorisations and regulates medical devices.

name: Mauritius Standards Bureau
description: Mauritius Standards Bureau and Ministry of Health together regulate food and pharmaceuticals. High alignment with EU standards due to EU market access.

name: Botswana Bureau of Standards
description: Botswana's standards bureau regulates food safety. SADC (Southern African Development Community) harmonisation applies for some standards.

name: Namibia Standards Institution
description: Namibia's standards institution and Medicines Regulatory Council jointly regulate food and pharmaceuticals. SADC standards apply.

name: National Medicines and Poisons Board Sudan
description: Sudan's national medicines regulatory authority under the Federal Ministry of Health. Issues pharmaceutical marketing authorisations.

name: Centre National de Pharmacovigilance et Matériovigilance Libya
description: Libya's pharmaceutical regulator under the National Centre for Disease Control and Ministry of Health.

name: Agence du Médicament de Madagascar
description: Madagascar's medicine agency regulates pharmaceuticals under the Ministry of Public Health.

name: Ministerio de Salud Pública y Asistencia Social Guatemala
description: Guatemala's Ministry of Public Health regulates pharmaceuticals and food safety. DQFB (Directorate of Pharmacy and Drug Regulation) issues drug registrations.

name: Dirección Nacional de Vigilancia de la Salud Honduras
description: Honduras's health surveillance directorate regulates pharmaceuticals and food safety.

name: Centro para el Control Estratégico de Drogas Costa Rica
description: Costa Rica's pharmaceutical regulator under the Ministry of Health. Issues drug registrations under RTCR (Costa Rican Technical Regulations).

name: Dirección Nacional de Farmacia y Drogas Panama
description: Panama's pharmaceutical and food regulator under the Ministry of Health. Issues drug registrations and food sanitary permits.

name: Centro para el Control Estatal de Medicamentos Cuba
description: Cuba's State Centre for Drug Control regulates pharmaceuticals and medical devices. Cuba has a strong domestic pharmaceutical industry.

name: Secretaría de Estado de Salud Pública Dominican Republic
description: Dominican Republic's Ministry of Public Health regulates pharmaceuticals and food safety. CAID (Drug Regulatory Agency) issues drug registrations.

name: Dirección General de Regulación Sanitaria Nicaragua
description: Nicaragua's pharmaceutical and food regulatory directorate under MINSA (Ministry of Health).

name: Dirección Nacional de Medicamentos Venezuela
description: Venezuela's pharmaceutical and food regulator under the Ministry of Popular Power for Health. Issues drug registrations.

name: Agencia Nacional de Regulación, Control y Vigilancia Sanitaria Ecuador
description: Ecuador's national health regulation agency (ARCSA) regulates food, drugs, cosmetics, and medical devices under LOSSANE (Organic Law of Health).

name: Agencia Estatal de Medicamentos y Tecnologías en Salud Bolivia
description: Bolivia's state agency for medicines and health technologies regulates pharmaceuticals and medical devices.

name: Dirección Nacional de Vigilancia Sanitaria Paraguay
description: Paraguay's national health surveillance directorate regulates food, drugs, and medical devices under MERCOSUR harmonised standards.

name: Ministerio de Salud Pública Uruguay
description: Uruguay's Ministry of Public Health regulates pharmaceuticals and food. MERCOSUR harmonisation applies for many product categories.

name: Gulf Standards Organisation
description: GCC-wide standards organisation issuing Gulf Standards (GSO) for food and consumer products. Standards mandatory across UAE, Saudi Arabia, Kuwait, Qatar, Bahrain, and Oman.

name: Ministry of Health and Medical Education Iran
description: Iran's Ministry of Health regulates pharmaceuticals, food, and medical devices. IFDA (Iran Food and Drug Administration) under the MoH issues registrations under Iranian national standards (ISIRI).

name: Jordan Food and Drug Administration
description: Jordan's comprehensive food, drug and device regulator. One of the most progressive regulators in the Arab region, with active international harmonisation.

name: Kuwait National Petroleum Company (food not applicable — MOH)
description: Kuwait's Ministry of Health regulates pharmaceuticals and food. Pharmaceutical registration aligns with GCC harmonised track.
